description: This file defines a class for handling SQLite database operations within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It includes methods for connecting, executing queries, managing transactions, retrieving metadata, and generating SQL specific to SQLite.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlite
classes.description: Driver class for SQLite database connection and operations within ADOdb, supporting transactions, metadata retrieval, and SQL generation.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sqlite
classes.description: Recordset class for fetching query results from SQLite database in different fetch modes within ADOdb.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the SQLite server version, description, and encoding.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a given table.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes driver capabilities.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last insert ID.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL for formatting dates.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SQLite database.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the SQLite database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID, managing a custom sequence table.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for ID generation.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops a sequence table.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index metadata for a table.

methods.name: charMax
methods.description: Returns max size for C type fields (no limit in SQLite).

methods.name: textMax
methods.description: Returns max size for X type fields (no limit in SQLite).

methods.name: month
methods.description: Returns SQL to extract month from date.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Returns SQL to extract day from date.

methods.name: year
methods.description: Returns SQL to extract year from date.
